items.title: Prime Video Takes Global on Turkish AI-Generated Movie 'Çukur:Vartolu,' a Spin-Off From the Hit Series 'The Pit'
items.excerpt: Prime Video has taken world rights on 'Çukur:Vartolu,' an AI-generated feature spun off from the Turkish hit series known internationally as 'The Pit' — a major streamer betting on a fully AI-made feature from an existing IP.

items.title: Generative AI Still Needs Artists' Judgment, Says Netflix's Eyeline GenFX Chief James Rustad at Busan
items.excerpt: At Busan's ACFM, Eyeline's James Rustad mapped Netflix's generative-AI VFX workflow, saying artists still decide which generated shots serve the story.

items.title: Brad Bird's 'Ray Gunn,' 'Toy Story 5' and Roger Deakins Lead View Conference Lineup as AI Debate Takes Center Stage
items.excerpt: Turin's View Conference (Oct. 12-16) puts AI's role in animation and VFX at the center of its 27th edition alongside Brad Bird, Roger Deakins and the 'Toy Story 5' and 'The Odyssey' teams.

items.title: 'It's Not Intuitive': 'Mad Max' Director George Miller Weighs In on AI's Creative Limitations
items.excerpt: George Miller tells Variety Australia where generative AI falls short as a filmmaking tool — arguing it lacks the intuition that drives directing decisions.

items.title: AI Tools Bring Efficiencies But Have Limitations, Says Weta CTO Kimball Thurston: "Tech Companies Should Collaborate More With Creatives"
items.excerpt: At Busan, Weta FX CTO Kimball Thurston, 'The Outlaws' director Kang Yun-sung and Netflix's Sung Q Lee weighed what AI tools speed up in production workflows and where they fall short. Thurston urged tech companies to work more closely with creatives.

items.title: Nicolas Cage Didn't Sign AI Waiver For 'Spider-Noir' & "Probably" Won't Work Again With "AI-Friendly" Amazon
items.excerpt: At NYCC, Nicolas Cage said he refused to sign an AI waiver for Prime Video's 'Spider-Noir' and probably won't work with the 'AI-friendly' streamer again — a performer-likeness flashpoint in AI production deals.

items.title: Busan's Asian Contents & Film Market evolves with added focus on AI and microdramas
items.excerpt: Busan's ACFM (Oct. 10-13) puts generative AI front and centre through InnoAsia. 44 organisations take part, and Kling AI co-hosts a session on how generative tech could reshape filmmaking.

items.title: Real-Time AI Worlds in Focus at Visko and Google Cloud's October 14 LA Fireside Chat
items.excerpt: Visko and Google Cloud will examine AI-generated environments that respond to user input while keeping continuity, and what they mean for previs, virtual production and games.

items.title: Call for Participation: USC Annenberg AI in Film and TV Survey
items.excerpt: Stacy L. Smith's USC Annenberg Inclusion Initiative is surveying above- and below-the-line film and TV professionals on how AI is affecting their work.

items.title: The Next Generation Speaks: What Young VFX Artists Are Doing Differently
items.excerpt: Young VFX artists, including ones at ILM, split on generative AI: some fold it into look development and iteration, others reject it on principle. They agree human judgment stays central.

items.title: Aaron Sorkin Explains What AI Gets Wrong About Storytelling
items.excerpt: In a wide-ranging interview, Aaron Sorkin explains why AI-generated scripts miss what makes storytelling work — a screenwriting-craft take on AI writing tools.

items.title: This New Trick Can Save a Ton on AI Video Generations
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge shows workflows for AI filmmakers to avoid wasting credits on bad generations before committing to full renders.

items.title: '부산행' VFX 장인이 만든 'AI 감독'…저작권 걱정 없는 K-롱폼에 '베팅'
items.excerpt: '부산행'·'반도' VFX를 이끈 정황수 대표의 더만타스토리가 시나리오에서 인물·조명·카메라 각도를 추출해 영상 시퀀스로 잇는 AI 영상 엔진 '더로드'로 롱폼 제작에 나섰다.

items.title: 모픽, '3D 씬'으로 영상 구도·카메라 연출 직접 다룬다
items.excerpt: 모픽이 AI 영상의 연출 무작위성과 구도 붕괴를 해결하는 3D 장면 연출 에디터 '3D 씬'을 출시했다 — 3D 마네킹과 카메라로 구도를 먼저 잡고 생성한다.

items.title: Latvian filmmaker wins AI film Grand Prix in Kazakhstan
items.excerpt: The first Astana AI Film Festival wrapped with Latvian filmmaker Nikolay Shestak taking the €400,000 Grand Prix from 8,000+ entries; the €1.8M fund splits prizes and investment in AI film projects.

items.title: Google Flow and Women in Film India launch Filmathon, with top five AI-made films headed to IFFI Goa 2026
items.excerpt: Google Flow and Guneet Monga Kapoor's WIF India launched an AI filmmaking 'Filmathon'; the top five AI-made films will screen at IFFI Goa 2026.
